subject: MAP Draft: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling, Structured Outputs)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Palmer <sara.palmer@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (integration milestone)

Hi Sara —

Great to meet today. Thanks for taking us through the integration goals and constraints for Acme Cloud. As promised, I’ve put together a short post-demo recap and the first draft of a Mutual Action Plan focused on the Integration Build Plan milestone (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs). Attaching the MAP draft and the integration workbook.

Key takeaways from today’s call:
- Primary integration: SDK-based embed + streaming generation for in-app assistants
- Required features: streaming, tool calling (calendar/DB lookup), structured JSON outputs for downstream routing
- Security/IT asks: VPC peering, audit logs, and encrypted keys (Vivek suggested KMS/HSM)
- Target pilot: internal product team (10k MAU) with a target close date for contract/sign-off: 2027-01-14

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Review attached MAP draft — confirm milestones and owners (due: 2026-12-03)
2) Technical deep-dive with Marissa to align on SDK integration details and streaming SLAs (schedule week of 12/6)
3) Secure security checklist evidence (Vivek to loop in security)

MAP highlights included in attachment:
- Milestone: Integration build plan (this covers SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)
  - Milestone owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood SE)
  - Customer owner: Alex Jenkins (Acme Cloud, Eng Manager)
  - Target date: 2027-01-10 (pilot ready)
  - Dependencies: VPC setup, API keys/KMS, data model for structured outputs, product API for tool endpoints

Please review and let us know any adjustments. If this looks good, I’ll move the MAP into HubSpot and create calendar invites for the technical deep-dive and security sync.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft)
- integration_build_plan_v1.xlsx (milestone workbook)

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (integration milestone)

Thanks Ben — really helpful recap. I reviewed the MAP and attachments with Alex and Michael. A few quick notes: 

- Target date: Can we move pilot-ready to 2027-01-17 instead of 1/10? We have an internal sprint already that week.
- Owners: Alex will own the customer-side coordination; I’ll own procurement timeline (we may need a PO)
- Dependencies: VPC peering might take longer depending on our infra team; request Vivek’s input on whether there’s an alternate path (managed connector)

Action items for Redwood: please add an explicit checklist for streaming SLA expectations (max tail latency we can expect) and a short doc on structured output examples we can provide to our schema team. Marissa — can you cover those in the technical deep-dive?

I’ll confirm availability for the week of 12/6 for the deep-dive after checking with Eng.

—Sara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP draft updated + proposed dates (integration build plan)

Thanks all — quick technical response and owners for the Integration Build Plan milestone. I’ve also added specific deliverables and dependencies below so Acme’s schema and API teams can see what we need.

Milestone: Integration build plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)
- Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (SE) — responsible for SDK integration guide, streaming config, tool calling examples, structured output templates
- Customer owner: Alex Jenkins (Acme Cloud, Eng Manager) — provide API endpoints, schema, test env access
- Target milestone date: 2027-01-17 (pilot ready)

Deliverables & responsibilities:
1) SDK integration guide (deliverable) — Marissa to produce v1 (docs + sample code) by 2026-12-10
   - Notes: will include JS/py SDK snippets, auth flow, connection examples for managed and self-hosted modes
2) Streaming SLA & config doc — Marissa + infra team to outline expected latencies and recommended batching profiles by 2026-12-12
   - Notes: will include head/tail percentile numbers and recommended max-token/window settings for 1s p95 targets
3) Tool calling playbook — sample tool wrappers for calendar and DB lookup by 2026-12-15
   - Dependencies: Acme to provide tool endpoint specs and auth method (OAuth or API key)
4) Structured outputs templates & schema mapping — sample JSON schema + validator rules by 2026-12-12
   - Dependencies: Acme to provide target schema and typical utterance-to-schema mappings
5) End-to-end test harness & sample payloads — Redwood to provide basic harness and sample payloads by 2026-12-20

Infrastructure/security dependencies (Vivek):
- VPC peering / connectivity checklist — Acme infra to request peering; if timeline slips, propose managed connector option (workaround)
- Key management: recommend KMS with customer-managed keys (we can support Dex/HSM options) — Vivek to provide KMS checklist by 2026-12-09
- Audit logging: confirm required retention (Acme to confirm) and provide sample log extract format

Risks & mitigations:
- Delay in schema/API spec delivery (risk) — mitigation: Redwood provides temporary mock endpoints and sample schema to accelerate dev
- VPC peering timeline (risk) — mitigation: managed connector + stricter least-privilege network ACLs for pilot

Please confirm owners & dates. Once confirmed, Ben — can you update HubSpot and kick off calendar invites for the technical deep-dive (I’m available 12/7 or 12/9 afternoon PST).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0178
